title.zh: Visa 财报披露稳定币结算年化规模超 250 亿美元，同比增长约 10 倍
title.en: Visa’s Stablecoin Settlement Volume Surpasses $25 Billion Annualized, Up 10x YoY

current_state.zh: Visa reported that its stablecoin settlement annualized volume has surpassed $25 billion, up about 10x year-over-year, with support across 10 blockchains and five stablecoins and its stablecoin pre-funding and cross-border flows now in commercial production.
